name: Ham 'n' Cheese Frittata with Honey Mustard Grape & Broccoli Slaw

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Place in a large bowl.
Small dice ham. Add to the bowl with the onion.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, ham, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place eggs, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 eggs
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

When the onion is done, reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 5-6 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set and cheese is melted, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry grapes; using a clean cutting board, cut grapes in half. Place in a clean large bowl along with broccoli slaw, dressing, and salt. Stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg red grapes
1 ½ (340 g) pkgs broccoli slaw
½ cup honey mustard dressing
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates; serve with slaw on the side. Enjoy!
